title: GRPO Beyond English: A Large-Scale Study of GRPO in Non-English and Multilingual Settings
abstract: arXiv:2608.13698v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), often optimized with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), has become a central recipe for improving the reasoning capabilities of pretrained language models but current studies remain heavily English-centric. We conduct a large-scale empirical study of multilingual and non-English GRPO across a wide range of base models, training languages, and different reasoning language rewards. We find that training to reason in the native language often leaves only a small gap to training for English reasoning. We further observe strong crosslingual transfer: training in one language often improves performance in many others. However, specific trends are highly model- and language-dependent. In some cases, training in a particular language induces severe regressions on out-of-domain capabilities in other languages. translated_title: 超越英语的GRPO：非英语和多语言环境下的GRPO大规模研究
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.13698v1 公告类型：新 摘要：基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR），通常通过组相对策略优化（GRPO）进行优化，已成为提升预训练语言模型推理能力的核心方法，但现有研究仍严重以英语为中心。我们对多语言和非英语GRPO进行了大规模实证研究，涵盖了广泛的基座模型、训练语言和不同的推理语言奖励。我们发现，使用母语进行推理训练与英语推理训练相比，性能差距通常很小。我们进一步观察到强大的跨语言迁移效应：用一种语言训练往往能提升其他多种语言的性能。然而，具体趋势高度依赖于模型和语言。在某些情况下，特定语言的训练会对其他语言的领域外能力造成严重退化。我们的分析表明，超越英语的RLVR可以提供广泛的跨语言能力。
tldr: 该研究通过大规模实验证明，非英语和多语言环境下的GRPO训练不仅与英语训练性能差距小，还能实现强跨语言迁移，但效果因模型和语言而异，并可能带来某些语言的性能退化。
en_tdlr: This study demonstrates through large-scale experiments that GRPO training in non-English and multilingual settings achieves performance close to English training and enables strong cross-lingual transfer, though effects vary by model and language, with potential regressions in certain languages.
